chapter_mission: Hold the book's intimate-scale Jedi register: Jacen and Ben on Coruscant in a training scene that subtly advances Jacen's mentorship and carries Vergere's philosophical shadow.
chapter_turn: Ben's relationship to Jacen tightens in exactly the shape the book's tragedy will require — Ben trusts Jacen's Force-philosophy more than he trusts his own uncertainty.

scene_plan.purpose: Jedi Temple training session — Jacen teaches Ben a kata; Ben trusts; Jacen watches.

exit_vector: Ben finishing a kata Jacen has taught him; Jacen watching with something that is not quite pride.
notes: The book's shortest chapter (~2761 words). Its job is relationship-level — the mentor bond that will be corrupted.
